- `pre_fix_expected_failure`, exit code `1`: the scientific workflow ran to

- `post_fix_success`, exit code `0`: the repaired workflow completed and the
  public consistency predicate held;
- `runner_failure`, exit code `2`: source import, dependency, fixture,
  calculation, timeout or other infrastructure failure.

Repaired the tensor-network norm reconstruction in [source/quimb/tensor/tnag/core.py](/workspace/task/source/quimb/tensor/tnag/core.py:3008).

The issue was in `norm_gloop_expand`:

- The generalized-loop calculation contracts the squared norm of a locally normalized copy.
- The returned local normalization product therefore needs to be applied after taking the square root.
- Any lazy `TensorNetwork.exponent` must also be restored.
- Omitted `gauges` are now treated as an empty mapping, matching the optional API contract.
